fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on illegal gambling devices (marble boards) and enforcement of Florida lottery laws; criticism of Dade County Purchasing Agent C. L. Wheat over alleged wasteful retail purchasing and conflict with county commissioners; coverage of Miami municipal politics and the return of "Sewellism" with discussion of a publicity board and Commissioner Sewell; reporting on Miami telephone rate disputes involving Southern Bell and the State Railroad Commission; and a crime story about lawyer O. B. White shooting Tribune reporter Shannon Cormack. Also includes columns, advertisements, and notices such as plans for a July 4 outing/picnic for children.
